standard_prerequisites: Original cited BV/minimal-surface/Plateau/Meeks-Yau/Steiner facts and already qualified2278 convexification; full author context preserved without re-proving prerequisites.
core_obligations: H3: Equivalence between the non-parametric partial-free-boundary minimization and the classical disk/annulus Plateau problem, including the two-disk degeneration. Even given Meeks-Yau existence, ordinary BV/perimeter facts and the cited Steiner equality theorem, the annulus case requires topology-driven simple connectedness of the projection, construction of the enclosed finite-perimeter region and a genuine annular parametrization of its symmetrized boundary, continuity through vertical tangent slices, and a rigidity argument forcing exactly two vertical intersections and opposite graph heights. The resulting original surface is itself symmetric and Cartesian, not merely a competitor of no larger area. Both directions and the strict area-gap/equality alternatives belong to one n=1,2 correspondence family; the easy disk case and helper lemmas are not separate counts.
